column3: The credits earned for the course or thesis are valid for up to seven years only (irrespective of whether the student was on leave or not).
The credits earned more than seven years back are deemed expired and must be earned again.
A student is not permitted to earn credits by registering for a course having more than 25% overlap with other approved courses which is already credited by the student.
Grades obtained in audit courses are not counted for computing SGPA/CGPA although the grade earned is reflected in the grade card or transcript.
A pass grade (other than F grade) is essential for completing an audit course.

V-type courses are lectures courses on special topics by external experts or NPTEL courses (at most 1-2 credits).
These courses shall run for duration not less than 1 month.
BTech students can take such courses maximum of 6 credits during the entire program.
Every course at IIT Bhilai conventionally runs for the entire semester (~14 weeks in case of a regular semester). Only exception is for V-type courses which may run for part of the semester.

column3: Each academic year comprises three semesters: two regular semesters (Monsoon and Winter) and a Summer semester.
The Summer semester is a shorter semester and only applicable for BTech and MSc programs.

column3: Institute core (IC) courses: A set of courses that every student of an undergraduate program at IIT Bhilai must register for and pass.
Program linked (PL) courses link basic (IC) courses and program core courses.
Program core (PC) courses: every student of the specific discipline must register for and pass them.
Program elective (PE) courses are selected from a bouquet declared by the discipline; students must pass the specified minimum number of credits.
Open elective (OE) courses are selected from a bouquet offered by various institute disciplines to meet minimum OE credit requirements.
Non-graded core (NC) courses are mandatory requirements and can be earned through formal academic activity and informal co-curricular or extra-curricular activities.
